name: Valvoline Global Operations
verdict: Owned by Saudi Aramco, which the Saudi state controls.

why.text: Valvoline’s global products business belongs to Saudi Aramco, and the Saudi state controls Aramco: the government holds about 81.5% directly and its fund PIF a further 16%. Saudi Arabia carried out a record 345 executions in 2024. A famous shirt makes the country look good to millions of fans while that goes on. That’s called sportswashing.
why.messageLine: Saudi Arabia carried out a record 345 executions in 2024.
